--[[
  Grandmother's Clean ESP
  No config, no fuss – just works.
  Press F1 to toggle.
--]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local enabled = true
local objects = {}

local function clear()
    for _, objSet in pairs(objects) do
        for _, obj in pairs(objSet) do
            obj:Remove()
        end
    end
    objects = {}
end

local function update(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then
        if objects[player] then clear() end
        return
    end

    local char = player.Character
    if not char or not char.Parent then
        if objects[player] then
            for _, obj in pairs(objects[player]) do obj:Remove() end
            objects[player] = nil
        end
        return
    end

    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if not head then return end

    local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToScreenPoint(head.Position)
    if not onScreen then
        if objects[player] then
            for _, obj in pairs(objects[player]) do obj.Visible = false end
        end
        return
    end

    local dist = (Camera.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude
    local size = math.clamp(150 / dist * 1.5, 20, 100)
    local x, y = pos.X - size / 2, pos.Y - size / 2

    local objs = objects[player]
    if not objs then
        objs = {}
        objs.Box = Drawing.new("Square")
        objs.Box.Thickness = 1
        objs.Box.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        objs.Box.Transparency = 0.7
        objs.Box.Filled = false

        objs.Name = Drawing.new("Text")
        objs.Name.Size = 14
        objs.Name.Center = true
        objs.Name.Outline = true
        objs.Name.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
        objs.Name.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)

        objs.HealthBg = Drawing.new("Square")
        objs.HealthBg.Thickness = 0
        objs.HealthBg.Filled = true
        objs.HealthBg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(50,50,50)
        objs.HealthBg.Transparency = 0.5

        objs.Health = Drawing.new("Square")
        objs.Health.Thickness = 0
        objs.Health.Filled = true
        objs.Health.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0)
        objs.Health.Transparency = 0.5

        objects[player] = objs
    end

    objs.Box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
    objs.Box.Size = Vector2.new(size, size)
    objs.Box.Visible = true

    objs.Name.Text = player.Name
    objs.Name.Position = Vector2.new(pos.X, y - 16)
    objs.Name.Visible = true

    local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    local hp = hum and (hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth) or 1
    local hw, hh = 30, 4
    local hx, hy = pos.X - hw/2, y + size + 2

    objs.HealthBg.Position = Vector2.new(hx, hy)
    objs.HealthBg.Size = Vector2.new(hw, hh)
    objs.HealthBg.Visible = true

    objs.Health.Position = Vector2.new(hx, hy)
    objs.Health.Size = Vector2.new(hw * hp, hh)
    objs.Health.Color = hp > 0.5 and Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0) or (hp > 0.25 and Color3.fromRGB(255,255,0) or Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0))
    objs.Health.Visible = true
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not enabled then clear() return end
    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do update(p) end
    -- cleanup
    for p in pairs(objects) do
        if not Players:FindFirstChild(p.Name) then
            for _, o in pairs(objects[p]) do o:Remove() end
            objects[p] = nil
        end
    end
end)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, p)
    if p then return end
    if i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F1 then
        enabled = not enabled
        if not enabled then clear() end
    end
end)

script:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Parent"):Connect(function()
    if not script.Parent then clear() end
end)

print("✅ Clean ESP loaded. Press F1 to toggle.")

	block.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic

	c.LastSpawn=tick()

local function checkVoid(c)

	if c.Object.Position.Y>-100 then
		return

	local closest
	local dist=math.huge

	for _,spawn in ipairs(c.SpawnPoints or {}) do

		if spawn.Parent then

			(c.Object.Position-
			spawn.Position).Magnitude

			if d<dist then

				dist=d
				closest=spawn

			end

		end

	end

	if closest then

		c.Object.Position=
		closest.Position+
		Vector3.new(0,4,0)

	end

end


local function checkGap(c)

	local params=RaycastParams.new()

	Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

	params.FilterDescendantsInstances={

		c.Object

	local ray=
	workspace:Raycast(

		c.Object.Position,

		Vector3.new(0,-6,0),

		params

	)

	if not ray then

		buildBlock(c)

	end

local function randomSpawn(c)

			if d < distance then

local function findNearbyCuboid(c)


	local closest

	for _,other in pairs(cuboids) do


		if other ~= c then

			other.Object.Position
			-c.Object.Position

			if d < distance then

				distance = d

	return closest

	updateFaceDistance()



	for _,c in pairs(cuboids) do



		local part =
		c.Object



		local target =

		------------------------------------------------

		c.SpeechTimer -= dt



		if c.SpeechTimer <= 0

			local other =

			if other then


				speak(part)

		-- STARE
		------------------------------------------------

			part.AssemblyLinearVelocity =

						part.Position+direction
					)

			end

		------------------------------------------------
		-- FOLLOW

			c.IdleTime=0
			c.Sleeping=false


			setFace(

				":D"
			)



			if target then


				local direction =
				(
				target.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
				-part.Position
				).Unit



				part.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
				direction*10



				if c.Type=="Cube"
				or c.Type=="Wedge" then


					part.CFrame =
					CFrame.lookAt(
						part.Position,
						part.Position+direction
					)


				end


			end


		end






		------------------------------------------------
		-- SOCIAL MODE
		------------------------------------------------

		if c.Mode=="Social" then



			c.IdleTime=0
			c.Sleeping=false



			local other =
			findNearbyCuboid(c)



			if other then

local function getNearestProximityPrompt(maxDistance)

local function sFLY(vfly)
	local char = waitForCharacter(LocalPlayer)
	repeat
		task.wait()
	until char and getRoot(char) and getHumanoid(char)

	disconnectKeys()

	local T = getRoot(char)
	local CONTROL = { F = 0, B = 0, L = 0, R = 0, Q = 0, E = 0 }
	local lCON = { F = 0, B = 0, L = 0, R = 0, Q = 0, E = 0 }
	local SPEED = 0

	local function FLY()
		getgenv().FLYING = true
		local BG = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
		local BV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		BG.P = 9e4
		BG.Parent = T
		BV.Parent = T
		BG.MaxTorque = V3_INF
		BG.CFrame = T.CFrame
		BV.Velocity = V3_ZERO
		BV.MaxForce = V3_INF

		task.spawn(function()
			repeat
				task.wait()
				if not T or not T.Parent or not LocalPlayer or not LocalPlayer.Character then
					getgenv().FLYING = false
					break
				end
				if not vfly then
					setPlatformStand(true)
				end

				local moving = CONTROL.L + CONTROL.R ~= 0 or CONTROL.F + CONTROL.B ~= 0 or CONTROL.Q + CONTROL.E ~= 0

				SPEED = moving and 50 or 0

				if moving then
					BV.Velocity = (
						(Camera.CFrame.LookVector * (CONTROL.F + CONTROL.B))
						+ (
							(Camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(
								CONTROL.L + CONTROL.R,
								(CONTROL.F + CONTROL.B + CONTROL.Q + CONTROL.E) * 0.2,
								0
							)).Position - Camera.CFrame.Position
						)
					) * SPEED
					lCON = { F = CONTROL.F, B = CONTROL.B, L = CONTROL.L, R = CONTROL.R }
				elseif SPEED ~= 0 then
					BV.Velocity = (
						(Camera.CFrame.LookVector * (lCON.F + lCON.B))
						+ (
							(Camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(
								lCON.L + lCON.R,
								(lCON.F + lCON.B + CONTROL.Q + CONTROL.E) * 0.2,
								0
							)).Position - Camera.CFrame.Position
						)
					) * SPEED
				else
					BV.Velocity = V3_ZERO
				end
				Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
				if Camera then
					BG.CFrame = Camera.CFrame
				end
			until not getgenv().FLYING

			CONTROL = { F = 0, B = 0, L = 0, R = 0, Q = 0, E = 0 }
			lCON = { F = 0, B = 0, L = 0, R = 0, Q = 0, E = 0 }
			SPEED = 0
			safeDestroy(BG)
			safeDestroy(BV)
			setPlatformStand(false)
		end)
	end

	if not mouse then
		return
	end

	flyKeyDown = mouse.KeyDown:Connect(function(KEY)
		local k = KEY:lower()
		if k == "w" then

		elseif k == "s" then

		elseif k == "a" then

		elseif k == "d" then
			CONTROL.R = iyflyspeed
		elseif k == "e" then
			CONTROL.Q = iyflyspeed * 2
		elseif k == "q" then
			CONTROL.E = -iyflyspeed * 2
		end
		pcall(function()
			Camera.CameraType = CAM_TRACK
		end)
	end)

	flyKeyUp = mouse.KeyUp:Connect(function(KEY)
		local k = KEY:lower()
		if k == "w" then
			CONTROL.F = 0
		elseif k == "s" then
			CONTROL.B = 0
		elseif k == "a" then
			CONTROL.L = 0
		elseif k == "d" then
			CONTROL.R = 0
		elseif k == "e" then
			CONTROL.Q = 0
		elseif k == "q" then
			CONTROL.E = 0
		end
	end)

	FLY()
end

	if not speaker then

	local char = waitForCharacter(speaker)

		end
	end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local Settings = {
    AutoRevive = true,
    ESP = true,
    TeamCheck = false,
    ESPColor = Color3.new(0, 1, 0),
    MaxDistance = 500,
}

local ESPObjects = {}
local Connections = {}
local ReviveCooldown = false

local function GetRemote(name)
    for _, remote in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
        if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") and remote.Name:lower():find(name:lower()) then
            return remote
        end
    end
    for _, remote in ipairs(game:GetService("ReplicatedFirst"):GetDescendants()) do
        if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") and remote.Name:lower():find(name:lower()) then
            return remote
        end
    end
    for _, remote in ipairs(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):GetDescendants()) do
        if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") and remote.Name:lower():find(name:lower()) then
            return remote
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function Revive()
    if ReviveCooldown then return end
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end
    if humanoid.Health > 0 then return end
    
    local reviveRemote = GetRemote("revive") or GetRemote("respawn") or GetRemote("resurrect")
    if reviveRemote then
        ReviveCooldown = true
        reviveRemote:FireServer()
        task.wait(2)
        ReviveCooldown = false
    else
        local respawn = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Respawn")
        if respawn then
            ReviveCooldown = true
            respawn:FireServer()
            task.wait(2)
            ReviveCooldown = false
        end
    end
end

local function IsDowned()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return false end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return false end
    if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return true end
    local downed = character:FindFirstChild("Downed") or character:FindFirstChild("IsDowned")
    if downed and downed.Value == true then return true end
    return false
end

local function CreateESP(player)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return nil end
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return nil end
    
    local esp = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    esp.Name = "ESP_" .. player.Name
    esp.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 80)
    esp.Adornee = root
    esp.AlwaysOnTop = true
    esp.MaxDistance = Settings.MaxDistance
    esp.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    esp.Parent = root
    
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    frame.Parent = esp
    
    local box = Instance.new("Frame")
    box.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 60)
    box.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -20, 0, 0)
    box.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
    box.BackgroundColor3 = Settings.ESPColor
    box.BorderSizePixel = 1
    box.BorderColor3 = Settings.ESPColor
    box.Parent = frame
    
    local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    nameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -20)
    nameLabel.Text = player.Name
    nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    nameLabel.TextScaled = true
    nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    nameLabel.Parent = frame
    
    local healthBar = Instance.new("Frame")
    healthBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 4)
    healthBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -4)
    healthBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 1, 0)
    healthBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    healthBar.Parent = frame
    
    local healthBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    healthBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 4)
    healthBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -4)
    healthBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    healthBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    healthBg.Parent = frame
    healthBg.ZIndex = 0
    
    return {
        Player = player,
        ESP = esp,
        Box = box,
        Name = nameLabel,
        HealthBar = healthBar,
        HealthBg = healthBg,
        Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid"),
        Root = root,
    }
end

local function UpdateESP(obj)
    local player = obj.Player
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then
        obj.ESP.Enabled = false
        return
    end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then
        obj.ESP.Enabled = false
        return
    end
    if Settings.TeamCheck and player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
        obj.ESP.Enabled = false
        return
    end
    local dist = (obj.Root.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
    if dist > Settings.MaxDistance then
        obj.ESP.Enabled = false
        return
    end
    obj.ESP.Enabled = true
    local health = humanoid.Health
    local maxHealth = humanoid.MaxHealth
    local healthPercent = math.clamp(health / maxHealth, 0, 1)
    obj.HealthBar.Size = UDim2.new(healthPercent, 0, 0, 4)
    obj.HealthBar.BackgroundColor3 = healthPercent > 0.5 and Color3.new(0, 1, 0) or
                                    healthPercent > 0.25 and Color3.new(1, 0.5, 0) or
                                    Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
end

local function OnRender()
    if Settings.AutoRevive and IsDowned() then
        Revive()
    end
    
    if Settings.ESP then
        for _, obj in pairs(ESPObjects) do
            UpdateESP(obj)
        end
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                local found = false
                for _, obj in pairs(ESPObjects) do
                    if obj.Player == player then
                        found = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not found then
                    local obj = CreateESP(player)
                    if obj then
                        table.insert(ESPObjects, obj)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    else
        for _, obj in pairs(ESPObjects) do
            obj.ESP.Enabled = false
        end
    end
end

function Evade:ToggleRevive()
    Settings.AutoRevive = not Settings.AutoRevive
    return Settings.AutoRevive
end

function Evade:ToggleESP()
    Settings.ESP = not Settings.ESP
    return Settings.ESP
end

function Evade:Init()
    Connections.RenderStepped = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(OnRender)
    Connections.PlayerAdded = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            task.wait(0.5)
            local obj = CreateESP(player)
            if obj then
                table.insert(ESPObjects, obj)
            end
        end
    end)
    Connections.PlayerRemoving = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
        for i, obj in pairs(ESPObjects) do
            if obj.Player == player then
                obj.ESP:Destroy()
                table.remove(ESPObjects, i)
                break
            end
        end
    end)
    print("[Evade] Loaded | AutoRevive: ON | ESP: ON")
    print("F1 to toggle AutoRevive | F2 to toggle ESP")
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F1 then
        local state = Evade:ToggleRevive()
        print("AutoRevive:", state and "ON" or "OFF")
    end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F2 then
        local state = Evade:ToggleESP()
        print("ESP:", state and "ON" or "OFF")
    end
end)

return Evade

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local Locked = false
local Target = nil


-- Create GUI
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Parent = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false


-- Create Button
local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
Button.Parent = ScreenGui
Button.Size = UDim2.new(0,60,0,60)
Button.Position = UDim2.new(0.8,0,0.7,0)

Button.Text = "👁️"
Button.TextScaled = true

-- Black button
Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)

-- Draggable
Button.Active = true
Button.Draggable = true


-- Find target in front
local function FindTarget()

	local Character = Player.Character
	if not Character then return end

	local Root = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not Root then return end

	local Closest = nil
	local Distance = math.huge

	for _, Plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

		if Plr ~= Player and Plr.Character then

			local TargetRoot = Plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if TargetRoot then

				local Direction = (TargetRoot.Position - Root.Position).Unit
				local Facing = Root.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(Direction)

				if Facing > 0.5 then

					local Dist = (TargetRoot.Position - Root.Position).Magnitude

					if Dist < Distance then
						Distance = Dist
						Closest = Plr.Character
					end

				end
			end
		end
	end

	return Closest
end


-- Toggle lock
Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	Locked = not Locked

	if Locked then
		Target = FindTarget()
	else
		Target = nil
	end

end)


-- Smooth camera lock
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

	if Locked and Target then

		local Root = Target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if Root then

			local NewCamera = CFrame.lookAt(
				Camera.CFrame.Position,
				Root.Position
			)

			Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(
				NewCamera,
				0.15
			)

		end
	end

end)
